Many permanent campers' May 2021; 'Pull through sites ... level sites' Nov 2021; 'Gravel pad, fairly level' Aug 2024) + Google review 'the spots are a little tight', read 2026-10-27

note: Small RV park beside I-25 (Exit 30) at Aguilar with an on-site cafe where guests check in; call ahead if arriving after hours. Camper-reported rate: $35 a night (Campendium, August 2024). --Claude
summary: Live: Google Maps lists it open (4.1 stars, 152 reviews, (719) 680-0861), the Facebook page gives the same phone and 'Always open', and a Campendium camper reported a stay in May 2026. No operator website (gearsrvpark.com does not resolve), so the camper-reported $35 (Aug 2024, the latest dated rate) stays; RV Life $$ also prices it. Added camper-reported full hookups to 50 amp and pull-through sites (method reported). Note trimmed of the RV Life line.
flags: Presence passes on Google (152 reviews + phone); the Facebook page's listed website gearsrvpark.com does not resolve, so there is no operator web page.

Some long-term residents reported (Campendium 2021: 'Many permanent campers', 'some longer-term residents'), but campers consistently book single nights; it reads as an overnight stop, not a long-stay park.
